claim: Watchlist functionality was added to TransferDesk.jsx
Users can star players and clubs in TransferDesk.jsx
Starred items are saved in localStorage
A Watchlist button was added that filters to show only starred items
The Watchlist button affects both the board tab and the stories tab
The file compiles without errors
The file renders server-side without errors
The server-side render covers the case where localStorage is not available
The implementation has not been tested in a browser
No changes have been committed to git
Transfer cards have a star next to the player or manager name
From and to clubs on transfer cards each have a small star that appears on hover
Club stars on transfer cards are always visible on touch screens
Free agent entries cannot be starred
Multiple clubs entries cannot be starred
Story cards have a star in the header for the club
Story cards have a star on each candidate row
Starring a player on the board also stars them in story views
The watchlist is stored under the localStorage key 'td-watchlist'
The watchlist is stored as an object with shape { players: [...], clubs: [...] }
The watchlist loads when the page opens
The watchlist saves on every change
If the browser blocks storage, stars still work for the current visit but are not persisted
Bad data in localStorage is ignored rather than crashing the page
The Watchlist button is positioned next to the search box
The Watchlist button displays a count of starred items
The Watchlist filter works together with the league filter
The Watchlist filter works together with the search box
Tab counts update to reflect the Watchlist filter
A transfer shows up in Watchlist filter if its player is starred
A transfer shows up in Watchlist filter if its from-club is starred
A transfer shows up in Watchlist filter if its to-club is starred
A story shows up in Watchlist filter if its club is starred
A story shows up in Watchlist filter if any candidate is starred
A story shows up in Watchlist filter if any candidate's current club is starred
Starring Atalanta causes the Man United story to appear because of Éderson
Enabling the Watchlist filter with nothing starred shows an explanatory message instead of empty columns
The story for 'Napoli & Milan' did not match any single club name
An optional 'clubs' field was added to the story data format
The 'Napoli & Milan' story has its clubs field set to ['Napoli', 'AC Milan']
Starring the 'Napoli & Milan' story header stars both Napoli and AC Milan
The clubs field was added to the backend format described in the comments at the top of the file
The breaking-news ticker ignores the Watchlist filter and always shows all items
The Watchlist filter state is not persisted across page reloads
Stars are matched to items by name rather than by ID
Story candidates do not have IDs
A star will not carry over if the live feed spells a name differently, such as with or without accents
